content.tex: A INVESTIGATION (QUESTIONS 1 TO 5)
ENCLOSED CUBOIDS (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This task is about the number of white cubes needed to enclose a grey cuboid with integer sides.
